description: This file implements CRC calculation using Neon SIMD instructions, including functions for byte and bit CRC calculations, with specific focus on polynomial-based CRCs (CRC24A and CRC24B). It includes optimized Neon routines for byte swapping, shifting, and folding data for CRC computation.

methods.name: neon_bswap
methods.description: Performs byte swap on a 128-bit Neon register.

methods.name: neon_shift_right
methods.description: Shifts Neon register right by specified number of bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_right_4
methods.description: Shifts Neon register right by 4 bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_left
methods.description: Shifts Neon register left by specified number of bytes.

methods.name: neon_shift_left_4
methods.description: Shifts Neon register left by 4 bytes.

methods.name: neon_clear_lower_4byte
methods.description: Clears the lower 4 bytes of a Neon register.

methods.name: neon_vmull_p64
methods.description: Performs polynomial multiplication on 64-bit Neon vectors with opcode control.

methods.name: crc32_folding_round
methods.description: Performs a folding round for CRC calculation.

methods.name: neon_safe_load
methods.description: Safely loads data into Neon register, handling unaligned data.

methods.name: neon_set_u64
methods.description: Creates a 128-bit Neon vector from two 64-bit integers.

methods.name: crc32_calc_pclmulqdq
methods.description: Calculates CRC using Neon-accelerated polynomial multiplication, handling data alignment and folding.
